subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Which Google Chat app-auth media-upload fallback branch should be the canonical implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89430?
rationale: This external PR is conflicting, has unresolved proof and correctness blockers, and overlaps with an open member-authored candidate for the same root cause, so automation should not pick a branch or waive proof on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Repair This Branch
options.body: Refresh this PR against current main, narrow the upload-scope predicate, preserve action send metadata, and require inspectable app-auth proof before final merge review.

options.title: Use The Member Candidate
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the canonical branch after it is refreshed and accepted.

options.title: Waive Live Proof Explicitly
options.body: Maintainers may accept source/API-contract proof without live Google Chat credentials, but the code blockers and conflict still need repair first.

recommendation.title: Repair This Branch
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR against current main, narrow the upload-scope predicate, preserve action send metadata, and require inspectable app-auth proof before final merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat reply-delivery history and maintainer-side timeline involvement make this the best available routing owner for the canonical-branch decision.
